ui.teamBridge.rename.menu.role: menu item in a conversation's "…" menu
ui.teamBridge.rename.menu.length: Short; one menu line beside an icon.

placeholders.kind: `channel` or `group`; selects the arm. Never translated or shown.

ui.teamBridge.rename.menu.note: Opens a small dialog to change the conversation's name. The ellipsis says a dialog follows; keep it (use the locale's ellipsis character). Only offered to the channel or group's administrator.

placeholders.kind: `channel` or `group`; selects the arm. Never translated or shown.

ui.teamBridge.rename.title.note: Title of the rename dialog. Same verb as the menu item, without the ellipsis.

placeholders.kind: `channel` or `group`; selects the arm. Never translated or shown.

ui.teamBridge.rename.description.note: Says the change is visible to every member. The channel arm also states the naming rule the field applies as you type: lower case, spaces become hyphens ("QA team" becomes "qa-team").

ui.teamBridge.rename.name.note: Label of the single name field.

ui.teamBridge.rename.cancel.note: Closes the dialog without saving. Use the locale's usual Cancel.

ui.teamBridge.rename.save.note: Saves the new name. Use the locale's usual Save.

ui.teamBridge.rename.saving.role: primary button label while the request is in flight
ui.teamBridge.rename.saving.length: One word plus ellipsis; must fit the Save button.
ui.teamBridge.rename.saving.note: Replaces Save while the server answers.

ui.teamBridge.rename.error.taken.role: inline error under the name field
ui.teamBridge.rename.error.taken.length: One sentence plus a short instruction.

placeholders.kind: `channel` or `group`; selects the arm. Never translated or shown.
placeholders.name: the name already in use, exactly as stored; never translated. The channel arm prefixes it with # like the sidebar does.

ui.teamBridge.rename.error.taken.note: Another channel or group in this organization already has the name the person typed. Name it so they know which one.

ui.teamBridge.rename.error.empty.role: inline error under the name field

ui.teamBridge.rename.error.too_long.role: inline error under the name field

placeholders.max: the maximum number of characters, a number (64)

ui.teamBridge.rename.error.too_long.note: The name is longer than the server allows. Characters here means visible characters (code points), not bytes.

ui.teamBridge.rename.error.characters.role: inline error under the name field
ui.teamBridge.rename.error.characters.note: The server refused a character in the name: a control character (tab, line break), an invisible character, or a space other than the ordinary space.

ui.teamBridge.rename.error.invalid.role: inline error under the name field
ui.teamBridge.rename.error.invalid.length: One sentence plus a short suggestion.
ui.teamBridge.rename.error.invalid.note: The server rejected the name for another reason.

placeholders.kind: `channel` or `group`; selects the arm. Never translated or shown.

ui.teamBridge.rename.error.forbidden.note: The server refused because the person is no longer an administrator of this conversation.

placeholders.kind: `channel` or `group`; selects the arm. Never translated or shown.

ui.teamBridge.rename.error.archived.note: Someone archived the conversation while the dialog was open; archived conversations cannot be renamed.

ui.teamBridge.rename.error.failed.note: Any other failure (network, server error). The old name is still in place.
